description: This file defines the VTWorkflowManager class for managing workflows within a vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, saving, deleting, serializing, and deserializing workflows, as well as defining the Workflow class for workflow instances. The file interacts with database objects to persist and retrieve workflow data and references external components like VTTaskManager and VTJsonCondition.

classes.name: VTWorkflowManager
classes.description: Manages creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, serialization, and deserialization of workflows in the CRM system.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a workflow in the database.

methods.name: getWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves all workflows from the database.

methods.name: getWorkflowsForModule
methods.description: Retrieves workflows associated with a specific module.

methods.name: getWorkflowInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a workflow based on its type.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a workflow by its ID from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a workflow and its associated tasks from the database.

methods.name: newWorkflow
methods.description: Creates a new workflow instance for a module.

methods.name: serializeWorkflow
methods.description: Exports a workflow to a JSON string.

methods.name: deserializeWorkflow
methods.description: Imports a workflow from a JSON string.

methods.name: getWorkflowsForResult
methods.description: Processes database query results into workflow objects.

classes.name: Workflow
classes.description: Represents a workflow instance with setup, evaluation, task execution, and state management methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes workflow properties from database data.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the workflow condition against an entity cache.

methods.name: isCompletedForRecord
methods.description: Checks if the workflow has been completed for a record.

methods.name: markAsCompletedForRecord
methods.description: Marks a record as having completed the workflow.

methods.name: performTasks
methods.description: Executes workflow tasks based on entity data.

methods.name: executionConditionAsLabel
methods.description: Returns or sets the execution condition's label.
